fact: The April 2019 Country Programme Document says the EMIS data collection, processing and reporting system needs contemporary technology and network infrastructure, and plans a comprehensive, integrated EMIS using ICT, strengthened in phases over the three-year GPE programme.
title: Government of the State of Eritrea, Ministry of Education: Access to Quality Education to All Eritreans, GPE Supported Programme (2018-2021), Country Programme Document
publisher: Ministry of Education, State of Eritrea
